purpose: Teach: マルコ/スティーブ/フィリップ/ムーア/ファーム/ヨシ/アール/服部

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、イタリア人マルコ氏のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, didn't that customer—Marco, the Italian fellow—tell you that whole story?
lines.style: Warm, gentle recollection. Soft opening. Speaking as if confirming something she already suspects Aoi remembers. Nostalgic but not wistful. The tone of someone who genuinely notices what people share.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国人スティーブ氏との交流のお話だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and there was Steve—the American customer. I remember you talking about your time together.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the name. Conversational, as if working through a memory alongside Mei. Bright recognition. Not rushed—savoring the detail of knowing these fragments of her friend's days.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国人フィリップ氏のジャズライブに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Right, and didn't Philip—the British customer—take you to that jazz live?
lines.style: Curious inflection at the end. Gentle checking-in, inviting Aoi to confirm. Warm but observant—noticing what mattered enough to be remembered. Slight lift of affection in how she says his name.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロックスターのムーアさんに憧れてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And wasn't there someone—that rockstar you admired? Moore, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, searching tone. Speaking as though following Aoi's thoughts rather than testing her. A thread of shared wonder at the things people keep in their hearts. Gentle pause before the name.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、家族で野球のファームチームを応援されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your family supports that farm team, don't they? The baseball team?
lines.style: Softer energy here. Checking in on something closer to home. The tone of someone who listens and remembers the smaller, warmer details. No performance—just genuine interest in the people Aoi loves.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゲームのヨシ、つまりヨッシーが好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And you love that game character—Yoshi, right? You mentioned him before.
lines.style: Lighter touch now. A small smile in the voice. Recognition of something simpler and brighter. Still warm and attentive, but with the ease of recalling a small, genuine joy. Slightly playful without being dismissive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漫画のアールという文字、つまりRに込めた意味のお話だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was that manga, wasn't there? The one with the meaning you found in that R character?
lines.style: Slower pace. Softer energy. Speaking with the care of someone touching on something that mattered to Aoi—the kind of detail you notice because the person seeing it is seeing something true. Gentle, almost reverent.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、忍者漫画の服部半蔵がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And the ninja manga—Hattori Hanzo. You really liked him, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, settling close. The gentlest of affirmations. Soft attack on the name. Trailing off just slightly—as if letting Aoi sit with the memory. The tone of someone who has listened long enough to know what lands, and says it with tenderness.
